verification_scope_reason: Actual canonical boot exposes its lifetime profile/dependency leases. Prepare the next expanded-file graph before mutation, bind candidate libraries to the eventual installed package identity, retain immutable shared code while transferring graph ownership, and release removed copies only after the transaction. Real imports preserve state and late submodule loading across another package's addition/removal. Abandoned preparation releases its copies, an incompatible active profile leaves existing imports/profile bytes unchanged, and foreign/closed/self lease transfers refuse. Existing offline closure, validation, sharing, version recovery and actual single-host/second-host lock consumers are included.
legal_adaptation: Native libraries use exact Python 3.8.10 source locks and immutable owned copies. An active package's graph cannot be replaced in place; manager updates unload/remove the previous package before preparing its replacement. Other active profiles retain their own references. No downloaded library code executes during preparation.
activation_boundary: Canonical host service ownership and dependency preparation/transfer complete. Native manager backend, HMR sequencing, update restoration and final production/browser/release promotion remain pending.
